newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: H1 results seen buoying Lisbon bourse through July.
newsitem.headline: H1 results seen buoying Lisbon bourse through July.

text.p: Expectations of strong half-year company results will keep Lisbon share prices buoyant throughout the month of July, Espirito Santo Research (ESR) said in its latest monthly newsletter.
"Half-year results, particularly bank results, due next month should be fairly positive," it said. "Together with U.S. macroeconomic data, this should keep the market upbeat."
The PSI20 .PSI20 share index has risen more than 55 percent since the beginning of the year.
